summary: @servicetitan/culture 41.3.3 executes obfuscated Bun-only payload from npm preinstall
details: The package advertises a small React culture/i18n Provider (dist/index.js exports one component) but declares `preinstall: "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style minified (identifiers like `_0x488df8`, per-function object-literal string tables mapping short keys to `--version`, `ignore`, etc.) and, when `bun` is not already on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line `@bun-cjs` bundle with a rotating string-array decoder (`hc1jfK9`, `WV8StW`), a large mixed numeric/string constant table, and no readable strings; it is not referenced anywhere in the library's runtime code path. Using an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bypasses Node-based inspection, and the payload's size and opacity are inconsistent with the trivial declared functionality. Installing this version causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
